Storage._comment_cloud: Set Provider=S3 + the fields below to enable the cloud tier (recommended target: Cloudflare R2 — ADR-009). For R2: Region='auto', ForcePathStyle=true, EndpointUrl=https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. Credentials go in secrets (ADR-006), never here.

OrderPhotoArchive._comment: Intent 024 promote-on-paid lifecycle (bolt 051). MaxAttempts × Backoff sets the per-order retry envelope; the backoff schedule is indexed by Attempt-1 and clamps at the last value. PromotionRecoverySweepIntervalHours is the periodic self-heal cadence (F1, review 043-v3).

Archive._comment: Intent 024 retention lifecycle (bolt 052). PurgeOriginalAtStatus must be 'Shipped' or 'Delivered'. RetentionMonths is measured from Order.PaidAt — see ADR-012.

Vat._comment: Intent 016 bolt 038 — Romanian VAT. Rate is snapshotted onto Order.VatRate at creation; changing this value does NOT mutate existing orders (legal trail). Shipping is VAT-inclusive at the same rate as goods (Romanian B2C convention). Rounding is MidpointRounding.AwayFromZero per ADR-019.

Seller._comment: Intent 016 bolt 039 — fiscal identity embedded in every UBL invoice and PDF. Validated at boot (SellerSettingsValidator). Single-tenant; per-request seller overrides are not supported.
Seller.Name: FotoTipar SRL

Anaf._comment: Intent 016 bolt 039 — ANAF SPV e-Factura submission. Flip Enabled=true once OAuth credentials + PKCS#12 cert are provisioned. With Enabled=false the OAuth flow, HTTP client, and InvoiceUploadJob are never wired: a paid order still gets its Invoice row and number, but no XML or PDF is built and the customer download endpoint always answers 404. Secrets (ClientSecret, CertPath, CertPassword) via env vars only (Anaf__*). Retry budget 1h/4h/16h/64h then Failed, derived from CreatedAt per ADR-024.

Invoicing._comment: Intent 016 bolt 039 dual-write rollout (ADR-022). No customer email integration exists yet, so this flag currently changes nothing customer-visible — flipping it true only swaps which log line InvoicePdfReadyNotifier writes. It becomes the real rollout seam once an email send path lands; until then the inspection week is the only thing it gates.

Sameday._comment: Intent 015 Sameday courier integration. Flip Enabled=true after credentials are provisioned in user-secrets (dev) or env vars (prod). With Enabled=false the static fallback IShippingService stays registered — see ADR-013/014. Credentials NEVER in appsettings.json (ADR-006).
Sameday._serviceIdsComment: Per-merchant Sameday service ids — set both to the real ids from your Sameday contract before enabling. 7 is a placeholder locker code.

Jobs._comment: Bolt 037 AWB + tracking lifecycle jobs. Orthogonal to Sameday:Enabled — keep Jobs:Enabled=false during initial rollout so credentials can be validated via the typed client before the workflow goes live. See ADR-015/016.

Sentry._comment: Intent 020 bolt 045 error tracking. Flip Enabled=true once Dsn is provisioned via user-secrets (dev) or env vars (prod). With Enabled=false the SDK is never constructed — production-identical to baseline. Dsn NEVER in appsettings.json (ADR-006). Release auto-derives from GIT_COMMIT_SHA env var (set by deploy workflow, bolt 040).

Observability._comment: Intent 020 bolt 044 OTel tracing + Prometheus metrics. Flip Enabled=true once an OTel collector + Prometheus are provisioned — read DEPLOYMENT.md §14 first. With Enabled=false the SDK is never wired and /metrics is absent — production-identical to baseline. Otlp.Endpoint blank means console spans in Development and no trace pipeline at all elsewhere; metrics are unaffected. /metrics is gated per ADR-018 (NOT by JWT) by ScrapePort (the listener allowed to serve it; 0 = every listener, dev only) and AllowedScrapeIps (addresses or CIDR). Behind a reverse proxy, set ScrapePort to a port the proxy does not route and never allow-list the proxy's own address. Sampling.Default is one service-wide trace rate, deterministic by trace_id per ADR-017; per-route rates are a collector concern (the sampler runs before routing). 0.0 keeps errored spans only.
